name: poisoned-dagger-class-bonus-curse
notes: Poisoned Dagger (0D6AfZyKXh, GeneratedMacroCode.php activateAbilityAbilities["0D6AfZyKXh:0"] / customDQHandlers["0D6AfZyKXh:0:ActivateAbility-1"]): "[REST], Banish CARDNAME: Deal 1 damage to target unit. Class Bonus: Until end of turn, if that unit were to take damage, it takes that much damage plus 1 instead." The dagger's own default template object enters with Status=1 (rested), matching its separate 'enters the field rested' clause -- since this fixture seeds it directly via BridgeAddToZone (bypassing that On Enter), Status is explicitly patched to 2 (ready) so the [REST] activation prereq (activateAbilityPrereqs requires Status==2) is payable. The champion is patched directly to Merlin, Memorite Vassal (ASSASSIN class) so IsClassBonusActive(player, ["ASSASSIN"]) is true. Activating the ability targets the opponent's champion: verified live it takes 1 damage and gains the 0D6AfZyKXh-CURSED TurnEffect tag (the Class Bonus's 'damage taken +1' curse marker). Break/restore verified: commenting out the DealDamage() call in ActivateAbility-1 leaves the champion undamaged and the fixture fails; restoring it passes again.

rulesClauses: [REST], Banish CARDNAME: Deal 1 damage to target unit. Class Bonus: Until end of turn, if that unit were to take damage, it takes that much damage plus 1 instead.
